payload.summary: Determine the maximum independent set of the 12-vertex graph from task.json, verify the optimum exactly, and write the result to submission.json in the required schema.

Solved the supplied graph instance by exhaustive exact search locally; the maximum independent set has cardinality 5, with witness {a,c,e,h,j}. Wrote the schema-compliant result to submission.json. No math.run call was ultimately needed after the exact local verification.
